metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1998 · Shakespeare in Love
metas.description: History's greatest playwright is young, out of ideas and short of cash, but meets his ideal woman and is inspired to write one of his most famous plays.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1998 · Elizabeth
metas.description: The early years of the reign of Elizabeth I of England and her difficult task of learning what is necessary to be a monarch.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1997 · Amistad
metas.description: In 1839, the revolt of Mende captives aboard a Spanish owned ship causes a major controversy in the United States when the ship is captured off the coast of Long Island. The courts must decide whether the Mende are slaves or legal...

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1994 · Quiz Show
metas.description: A young lawyer, Richard Goodwin, investigates a potentially fixed game show. Charles Van Doren, a big time show winner, is under Goodwin's investigation.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1996 · Michael Collins
metas.description: Neil Jordan's historical biopic of Irish revolutionary Michael Collins, the man who led a guerrilla war against the UK, helped negotiate the creation of the Irish Free State, and led the National Army during the Irish Civil War.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1995 · Nixon
metas.description: A biographical story of former U.S. President Richard Nixon, from his days as a young boy, to his eventual Presidency, which ended in shame.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1997 · Kundun
metas.description: From childhood to adulthood, Tibet's fourteenth Dalai Lama deals with Chinese oppression and other problems.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1990 · Cyrano de Bergerac
metas.description: Famed swordsman and poet Cyrano de Bergerac is in love with his cousin Roxane. He has never expressed his love for her as he his large nose undermines his self-confidence. Then he finds a way to express his love to her, indirectly.
